items.title: Celebrating 25 years of visual search innovation
items.summary: Google Images is turning 25. Here’s a look back at some major milestones — and new ways to explore and create visual content.
items.summaryZh: 为庆祝Google Images诞生25周年，谷歌宣布在其搜索的AI Overviews中集成图像生成功能。该功能基于其最新的Nano Banana模型，能够将简单的文本提示直接转换为从头生成的自定义高质量视觉内容，拓展了视觉搜索与创造的边界。

aiReview.reasonZh: 谷歌在Google Images成立25周年之际，在搜索的AI概览中引入了基于Nano Banana模型的图像生成功能。

items.title: How to manage AI investments in the agentic era
items.summary: Learn how enterprises can manage AI investments in the agentic era by measuring useful work per dollar, improving efficiency, and scaling high-value workflows.
items.summaryZh: 该文章探讨了企业在智能体时代（Agentic Era）如何科学管理人工智能投资，核心建议包括通过衡量每美元带来的有用工作量、提升运行效率以及规模化部署高价值工作流来优化AI回报。原始信息显示：Learn how enterprises can manage AI investments in the agentic era by measuring useful work per dollar, improving efficiency, and scaling high-value workflows.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“How to manage AI investments in the agentic era”。其重要性主要体现在：OpenAI发布了关于企业如何在智能体时代管理AI投资、度量投入产出并扩展高价值工作流的指南。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。

items.title: Data science workflows with ChatGPT Work
items.summary: Learn practical ChatGPT Work workflows for root-cause briefs, KPI memos, scoped analyses, and dashboard specifications.
